name: Attack area experiment
description: Experiment, not a design: the basic Attack (action 150) gets the area and arc of Spiral Cut (action 394, an enemy sweep): radius 4 around the target, 180-degree arc. Native AoE targeting decides who is caught. Every weapon and every unit that uses Attack 150 is affected, and Ivalice Together's private catalogue still lists Attack as single-target, so co-op menus won't show the area.
